title: Racing the Clock: Teaching VLNs Budget-Conditioned Object Search
description:
arXiv:2611.17442v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: A rescue robot entering a building with thirty seconds on the clock should sprint toward the single most promising room; given ten minutes, it should instead explore a broader tour. Yet vision-language-navigation (VLN) models are typically evaluated under a fixed episode limit that the policy never observes, even though time-critical missions require behavior to adapt to the available budget.
